name: 46582 · Warsaw, IN
findings: ZIP 46582 (Warsaw) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46582 (Warsaw) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46582 (Warsaw) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
